verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe the full loop. You fine-tune a supported base model on your own data (LoRA or full fine-tuning), launched from the console, API/SDK or CLI. Together then handles data upload, training, hosting and inference, and dedicated endpoints explicitly accept a model you fine-tuned from a supported base model. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the fine-tune-to-deploy workflow (all evidence is vendor docs).
